en: This is a multi-image postcard composed of several black-and-white photographs depicting African men, women, and children, as well as scenes of daily life, buildings, and people sitting in groups outdoors. Several photographs are labeled with handwritten captions in what appears to be Swedish. There is a prominent portrait labeled 'Namfuku' at the top center, surrounded by smaller portraits and group scenes. The settings include buildings that resemble colonial-era houses and people in typical early 20th-century attire.
